card.name: Warning to stop at first skin rash
card.fires_on: The words "of" and "skin" in the phrase "discontinue the use of [drug] at the first appearance of skin rash", in NSAID patient-counseling text about serious skin reactions.

modes.label: "of" after first appearance
modes.description: The linking word "of" right after "at the first appearance" in the stop-at-rash instruction.
modes.example: and to discontinue the use of piroxicam capsules at the first appearance<< of>> skin rash or any other sign of hypers

modes.label: "skin" before rash
modes.description: The word "skin" that follows "first appearance of" and leads into rash.
modes.example: and to discontinue the use of flurbiprofen at the first appearance of<< skin>> rash or any other sign of hypersensitivity

card.plain: It marks the standard warning line about stopping the drug when a skin rash first shows up.
